name: Sega SG-1000
description: Sega's first home video game console, a Z80-based cartridge system released in Japan in July 1983. It led directly to the Mark III and the Master System, starting Sega's line of home hardware.
curiosities: It went on sale in Japan on 15 July 1983, the same day as Nintendo's Famicom.
Sega sold a home-computer sibling, the SC-3000, that ran the same cartridges.
Its video chip is the same TMS9918 family used in the ColecoVision and MSX computers.
Its successor, the SG-1000 Mark III, was redesigned as the Master System for the West.
